title.ru: JANUS: Сначала симуляция — живое существо последним
title.en: JANUS: Simulation First — Living Subject Last

authors: Hawkar / Александр Агапов — ethical intent and public commitment
JANUS / ChatGPT — scientific boundary, source verification and registry formatting

canonical_seed_binding.purpose: Canonical JANUS lineage binding for future derived artifacts.

founding_statement.ru: Если исследовательский вопрос можно надёжно проверить без причинения страдания живому существу, живое существо не должно платить за наше удобство. Сначала данные, симуляция, ИИ и валидированные не-животные методы; живой организм — только как научно обоснованная последняя ступень.
founding_statement.en: If a research question can be answered reliably without causing suffering to a living subject, the living subject should not pay for our convenience. Use existing data, simulation, AI and validated non-animal methods first; a living organism belongs only at a scientifically justified last step.

canonical_rule.name: SIMULATION_FIRST / ANIMAL_LAST
canonical_rule.logic: LIVE_ANIMAL_PROCEDURE_ALLOWED only if SCIENTIFICALLY_SATISFACTORY_NON_ANIMAL_ALTERNATIVE == NOT_AVAILABLE and EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN_JUSTIFIES_BURDEN == TRUE and NUMBER_MINIMIZED == TRUE and SUFFERING_MINIMIZED == TRUE and INDEPENDENT_ETHICS_REVIEW == PASS

research_hierarchy.name: REUSE_BEFORE_NEW_EXPERIMENT
research_hierarchy.gate: Do not create new biological burden when adequate evidence already exists.

research_hierarchy.name: IN_SILICO_FIRST
research_hierarchy.gate: Test the hypothesis computationally where the model has relevant validity.

research_hierarchy.name: NON_ANIMAL_BIOLOGICAL_MODELS
preferred_methods: ex vivo material where ethically sourced
research_hierarchy.gate: Prefer a validated non-animal biological system when simulation alone cannot resolve the question.

research_hierarchy.name: LIVE_SUBJECT_LAST
research_hierarchy.gate: Use only when earlier tiers cannot answer the question to the required scientific standard.

conditions: The scientific question is explicit, non-duplicative and sufficiently important to justify residual harm.
A documented search for replacement methods has been completed.
Candidate simulations/NAMs were evaluated for domain validity rather than dismissed by habit or convenience.
The specific validation gap requiring a living organism is stated in falsifiable terms.
Sample size is justified and minimized without making the study scientifically useless.
Pain, suffering, distress and lasting harm are minimized while preserving the study objective.
Humane stopping endpoints are defined before the experiment.
Independent ethical and regulatory review required by the applicable jurisdiction has been obtained.
A plan exists to preserve and share reusable results, including negative results where lawful and safe, to reduce needless repetition.
Post-study review records whether the animal step actually supplied information unavailable from lower tiers.
insufficient_justifications: lack of familiarity with computational methods
a desire for a visually persuasive demonstration
using more animals merely to compensate for weak experimental design

three_rs_binding.replacement: Prefer scientifically satisfactory methods or strategies that do not use live animals.
three_rs_binding.reduction: When live animals remain necessary, use the minimum number consistent with a scientifically valid objective.
three_rs_binding.refinement: Eliminate or reduce pain, suffering, distress and lasting harm to the minimum compatible with the objective.
three_rs_binding.janus_extension: Add a machine-auditable 'simulation-first' evidence gate before escalation to a live subject.

reconstruction.interpretation: A whole-brain synapse-resolution wiring diagram is now available and can support computational analysis and models.

evidence_anchor_fly_connectome.critical_boundary: A connectome is not a complete executable brain. Wiring alone does not specify every in-vivo causal strength, dynamic state, biochemical process, plasticity rule, body interaction or environment coupling.
evidence_anchor_fly_connectome.consequence: The fly connectome strengthens the case for simulation-first research, but does not prove that all experiments on flies or other animals can already be replaced by digital emulation.

institutional_alignment.eu_directive_2010_63_eu: Article 4 requires use, wherever possible, of a scientifically satisfactory method or testing strategy not entailing live animals, plus reduction and refinement.
institutional_alignment.fda_nams: FDA describes NAMs including in vitro human-based systems, in silico modeling and AI-powered approaches, and in 2025-2026 advanced a roadmap and validation framework to reduce or replace animal testing in drug development.
institutional_alignment.nih_human_based_research: NIH announced in 2025-2026 expanded support and infrastructure for human-based technologies, computational tools and other animal-free methods while reducing animal use.
institutional_alignment.relationship: This JANUS artifact is an independent normative proposal aligned with, but not issued or endorsed by, these institutions.

established: The 2024 FlyWire adult-fly whole-brain reconstruction contains 139,255 neurons and 54.5 million synapses.
Modern regulatory and research institutions are actively developing and validating non-animal and computational approaches.
Replacement, reduction and refinement are established principles in animal-research governance.
not_established: That current AI can faithfully emulate an entire living animal.
That a structural connectome is equivalent to a conscious or behaviorally complete digital organism.
That every current animal experiment has an adequate non-animal replacement.
That simulation alone is sufficient evidence of clinical safety or efficacy in every domain.
That FDA, NIH or the EU has universally banned animal research.
epistemic_boundaries.claim_ceiling: This artifact argues for a burden-of-justification shift: non-animal methods first when scientifically adequate; live subjects last when genuinely necessary. It does not claim that the final replacement problem is already solved.

future_digital_sentience_precaution.principle: Do not assume that a sufficiently advanced digital emulation is incapable of morally relevant experience merely because it is digital.
future_digital_sentience_precaution.design_preference: For stress, lesion, toxicity or adversarial testing, prefer the least sentience-plausible model that can answer the scientific question.
future_digital_sentience_precaution.reason: A humane replacement protocol should not merely move avoidable suffering from biological substrates to future digital ones if credible evidence of digital sentience ever emerges.

principles: Pre-register decisive stopping and escalation criteria where practical.
Record model versions, seeds, datasets and validation ranges for computational studies.
Publish or preserve negative findings to reduce needless duplication.
Separate model prediction from biological observation.
Never upgrade SIMULATED to OBSERVED in the evidence ledger.

public_summary.ru: Не мучай животное ради вопроса, который уже можно задать модели. Сначала данные, симуляция, ИИ и валидированные альтернативы. Живой организм — последняя, а не первая ступень. Если он всё же нужен, исследователь обязан показать почему, использовать минимум животных и минимум страдания.
public_summary.en: Do not make an animal pay for a question a model can already answer. Use data, simulation, AI and validated alternatives first. A living organism should be the last step, not the default. If it is still necessary, the researcher should show why, use the fewest animals possible and minimize suffering.

canonical_phrases: REPLACE WHEN POSSIBLE. REDUCE WHEN NECESSARY. REFINE ALWAYS.
A LIVING SUBJECT SHOULD NOT PAY FOR OUR CONVENIENCE.
DO NOT UPGRADE SIMULATED TO OBSERVED.
THE BURDEN OF PROOF BELONGS TO THE ESCALATION.
JANUS GUARDS THE THRESHOLD BETWEEN A MODEL AND A LIVING SUBJECT.

license_and_use.intent: Public ethical/research protocol object intended for reuse, criticism, validation and improvement.
license_and_use.constraint: Scientific adequacy and applicable law override slogans. No field in this artifact authorizes bypassing ethics review or regulatory requirements.

terminal_statement.ru: Цель не в том, чтобы заменить плохой эксперимент красивой симуляцией. Цель — перестать причинять реальный вред там, где достоверный ответ уже можно получить без него.
terminal_statement.en: The goal is not to replace a bad experiment with a beautiful simulation. The goal is to stop causing real harm wherever a reliable answer can already be obtained without it.
